warnings: Members from the S-02 หมายเหตุ legend (reprinted on S-03 / S-04): thin = แป C-75x45x15x1.6mm. @1.50 m., solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x2.3 mm., heavy dash-dot = อะเส C-100x50x20x3.2 mm., and one line style each for TRUSS T1-T5. Truss members are the 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x1.7 mm.' of the truss elevations (slashed-rectangle symbol read as a box section, designation RHS, print kept).
Low mono-pitch roof over bay 2-3, drawn from grid 2 to 3' (7.00) and from A'' (-1.00) southwards; its south edge between D and E prints no dimension, so no line was made for it.

T1 (rows A, B) continues here from S-02 (break line near grid 2): only its low-roof half 2-3 and the 1.00 overhang past grid 3 are recorded here. T4 runs on grid 3 split at the columns A3, B3, D3 (no column at C3). T5 runs on row D from T3 (grid 2, no column at D2) to the column D3, plus its 1.00 overhang.
T3 on grid 2 is drawn here too (labelled T3) but recorded only in the S-02 file. T5 is reprinted on S-04 and recorded only here.
